# Alameda County Healthy Homes Department

> > Alameda County Healthy Homes Department provides lead poisoning prevention, housing rehabilitation services, and healthy homes programs for residents, property owners, contractors, and healthcare providers in Alameda County, California.

The department, part of the Community Development Agency (CDA), offers lead hazard inspection and repair, contractor training, multilingual educational resources, and housing grants. Key staff include Sandra Rivera and April Williamson, serving communities across Alameda County with comprehensive lead poisoning prevention and housing safety programs.

## Key Topics

- Lead Poisoning Prevention
- Healthy Homes Department
- Lead Hazard Repair
- Housing Rehabilitation
- Property Owner Services
- Contractor Training & Certification
- Community Development Agency (CDA)

## Core Services & Programs

- [Healthy Homes Department Homepage](https://achhd.org): Homepage for Alameda County Healthy Homes Dept lead prevention services
- [Housing Services](https://www.achhd.org/housingservices.htm): Housing rehabilitation, grants, and lead hazard repair services
- [Contractor Resources](https://achhd.org/contractors/contractors.htm): Contractor resources for lead-safe work and hazard repair services
- [Code Enforcement Officer Resources](https://achhd.org/code-enforcement-officers/code-enforcement-officers.htm): Resources for code enforcement officers on lead hazard compliance

## Training & Education

- [Lead-Safe Work Classes for Contractors](https://achhd.org/classes/leadtrain.htm): Lead-safe work training classes for contractors in Alameda County
- [Educational Video Playlist](https://www.achhd.org/leadpoisoning/video-list.htm): Multilingual educational videos on lead poisoning and EPA certification
- [Reducing Lead Hazards from Paint and Soil](https://achhd.org/leadpoisoning/hazard.htm): Guide to reducing lead hazards from paint and soil contamination

## Lead Sources & Health Information

- [Lead in Ceramic Dishes & Cookware](https://www.achhd.org/leadpoisoning/ceramic.htm): Guide on lead sources in ceramic dishes and cookware safety
- [Lead Sources in Gardening](https://www.achhd.org/leadpoisoning/gardening.htm): Information on lead sources in gardening and environmental health
- [Medical Provider Case Data](https://achhd.org/medicalproviders/casedata.htm): Lead poisoning case data for medical providers and healthcare pros
